Dharmendra Pradhan Resigns; Parliament Reaction and Political Commentary

Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned from his post. Following his resignation, he received a "grand welcome" in Parliament. Congress leader Gaurav Gogoi criticized this welcome. The Quint described Pradhan's resignation as both a "win and a warning," while Newslaundry focused on Prime Minister Modi's decision-making process behind the resignation.
